liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **mmj2007-03-10d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **mmj2007-03-10d1t08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **mmj2007-03-10.4011s.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 123 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [1]
- **MMJ_Langerado**: source not stated; 19 songs; 123 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: The audio quality of the recording is described as pretty good [5]
- **mymorningjacket2007-03-10.mbho.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 120 min [3]
- **mymorningjacket2007-03-10.mbho.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 120 min [4]

## Around the show

- The main stage crowd was heavily engaged and rocked hard that night [7]
- Reviewer moved from NW PA to SW FL before attending this first Langerado [11]
- Tied with Matisyahu as one of the best acts at the festival [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2007-03-10.4011s.flac16**: taped by Mark Lynn; transferred by Mark Lynn; source: FOB DFC DPA(B&K)4011s->Luminous Monarchs->V2->Luminous Synchestra Signature XLRs->AD2K@ 16/44.1->HHB portaDAT [1]
- **MMJ_Langerado**: taped by Brent Stober; transferred by Brent Stober; source: FOB NOS Schoeps mk41>kc5>cmc6>Sonosax SX-M2>Sound Device 702@24/48 [2]
- **mymorningjacket2007-03-10.mbho.flac24**: taped by Peter W. King; transferred by Peter W. King; source: mbho603a/ka500hn (hypercardioid, DIN) > mp2 > busman t-mod edirol r4 (24/96) [3]. Also: 24-bit fileset sourced from hypercardioid mics via mp2 to Edirol R4 [3]
- **mymorningjacket2007-03-10.mbho.flac16**: taped by Peter W. King; transferred by Peter W. King; source: mbho603a/ka500hn (hypercardioid, DIN) > mp2 > busman t-mod edirol r4 (24/96) [4]. Also: 16-bit fileset processed from 24/96 source using SoundForge 10.0 [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by George Weiss, John Metzger: [Langerado Music Festival 2007 - My Morning Jacket (Photo Journal)](http://www.musicbox-online.com/reviews-2007/langerado-2007-my_morning_jacket.html) [18]
- Fan art by George Weiss, John Metzger: [Langerado Music Festival 2007 - My Morning Jacket (Photo Journal)](http://www.musicbox-online.com/reviews-2007/langerado-2007-my_morning_jacket.html) [19]
